import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        Arrays.sort(a);
        int ans = 1;
        int lo = 1, hi = n;
        while (lo <= hi) {
            int mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
            boolean ok = false;
            for (int i = 0; i + mid <= n; i++) {
                if (a[i + mid - 1] - a[i] <= T) {
                    ok = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (ok) {
                ans = mid;
                lo = mid + 1;
            } else {
                hi = mid - 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
